name: the spendthrift
note: Grants whatever is asked and promises whatever is wanted. The Crown pays for a while.

name: the miser
note: Refuses on principle and lets the post pile up. Cheap, and nobody likes him.

name: the steady hand
note: Middling: pays part, holds rates, and keeps the governor pointed at growth.

name: the absentee
note: Answers nothing at all. The reference for what silence alone does (SPEC 9.3).

name: the steady hand, tea untaxed
note: The steady hand with tea at the base rate. The control for the tea duty.

name: the steady hand, tea taxed hard
note: The steady hand with a heavy duty on tea. What taxing the one comfort the colony cannot grow actually does (SPEC 10.2).

name: the steady hand on poor ground
note: The steady hand, founded well down the list of sites instead of on the best food in reach. What a town that cannot feed itself actually does.

name: the tyrant
note: Raises every rate he is offered and refuses every request. The profile rebel-sentiment.md section 8 names: a player who taxes sharply and denies his governors should see a first rebellion in years 2-3.

name: the pleader, everywhere
note: Writes desperate on everything, answers included, where there is no compliance step to buy and the plea costs a loyalty step and an undecaying mark for nothing. The naive half of tone.md section 3's pair.

name: the pleader, where it buys something
note: The same player, pleading only where there is a compliance step to move and answering plainly. Against the naive pleader this is what section 3 costs a player who has not read it.

name: the bully
note: Contempt, and a threat wherever the game will take one. The register tone.md section 9 calls playing with matches, and the one that should show mettle's spread as a bimodal answer rather than a uniform shift.

name: the courtier
note: Flattery throughout and never a threat. Buys a chattier desk and a great many letters put in a drawer, which is the cost section 6 says pleased carries.

name: the impatient
note: Peevish everywhere and never a threat. tone.md section 6 calls annoyed the cheap, soft version of harshness - half of it, promptly, when you need it this month and do not much mind the cost - and it is the one register no reference player had.
